prose: Axios reports Bill Gates warning about the catastrophic risk of 'people with ill intent using the latest AI tools', which he says are powerful enough to 'cause a billion deaths'. The framing puts misuse - bioterror and similar deliberate abuse by bad actors - at the top of the risk agenda, as opposed to accidents or misalignment. The article is paywalled, so this summary is based on the headline and lead captured by the feed.
highlights: Gates warns of ill-intentioned misuse of latest AI tools.
Says they are powerful enough to 'cause a billion deaths'.
Frames deliberate misuse as the catastrophic risk.
Axios piece paywalled; summary from headline/lead.
